sample_rate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz (common values: 44100, 48000, 96000)

channels.description: Number of audio channels (1 = mono, 2 = stereo)

format.description: Audio sample format as reported by ALSA (e.g., s16_le, s24_3le, s32_le, float_le)

period_size.description: Frames per period (lower = lower latency, higher CPU usage)

periods.description: Number of periods in the ring buffer (buffer depth = period_size × periods)

use_softvol.description: Enable software volume control via ALSA PCM (required for some USB devices)

log_level.description: Minimum log level for debugging and diagnostics

mixers.description: List of ALSA mixer controls to expose via OSS mixer API

index.description: Mixer element index (0 for first element of named control)

buffer_delay.description: Poll delay in milliseconds between buffer refill attempts

use_shm.description: Use shared memory (SHM) for zero-copy audio streaming (requires OSS Proxy Daemon ≥ 4.2)
